clock: Runtime timestamps are UTC; screenshot offsets are local media positions.
revision_note: The app source was not modified during the recorded demo. The worktree contains documentation and packaging changes; the revision alone does not describe those uncommitted files. Checksums establish export integrity, not an independent timestamp or signature.

target.fixture: Fresh isolated synthetic instance. Working database and authentication state are not exported.

replay.model_calls_note: No model tool activity is present. Deterministic execution uses Execution in electron/executor.cts and does not call a model. This export does not include an independent network trace.

repair.result: Human clarification pending; no validated repair claimed.

video.notes: Idle periods shortened; one discovery segment labeled 2x; private authentication entry excluded.

export_method.events: Persisted journal entries serialized as JSONL without changing values, labels, timestamps, sequence numbers, or embedded safe evidence. The failed session is split at the explicit repair boundary.
export_method.sessions: Only named metadata, messages, tool status, control, pending request and execution fields are exported; raw history and browser profile are not.
export_method.outputs: Executor outputs are removed by persistence. presented-output.json is explicitly derived from the preserved Capability chat message; the original redacted execution object is retained separately.
export_method.inputs: Invocations are separately annotated from recorded UI or validation fingerprints; redacted stored inputs are not overwritten.
export_method.artifacts: Original JSON, generated JavaScript and validation sidecar copied byte for byte; no hand repairs or new successful-run claims.
export_method.privacy: All exported identifiers and visible records belong to the synthetic portal. Authentication input, cookies, tokens, signing keys, .env, raw model context, and session databases are excluded.
